title: The Echo Through the Cliffs
intro: Imagine a valley where dwellings are hewn from cliffs, and the air carries the memory of a warning unheeded. A people once thrived here, blessed yet defiant, until a sign emerged from the very rock they trusted.
clues: We were a people who carved out secure homes from the mountains, feeling safe in our rocky dwellings.
We lived in a land of plains and stone, blessed with gardens and springs.
A messenger from among us came, calling us to abandon our false gods and worship the One true Creator.
We arrogantly set a condition for belief: a unique sign that would emerge from the very rocks we carved.
When the promised she-camel appeared from the rock, a clear sign, our elite still refused and hamstrung her despite the warning of an impending doom.
Three days after our deed, a thunderous blast echoed through the valley, and we were reduced to fallen rubble, our homes our graves.

trial.label: Our Trial/Main Event
options: The worship of the golden calf
The building of a tower to the sky

outcome.label: Our Outcome
options: A rain of stones from the sky
A flood that covered the earth
A fierce wind that uprooted us

arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَـٰلِحًا أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ فَإِذَا هُمْ فَرِيقَانِ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
verse: And We had certainly sent to Thamūd their brother Ṣāliḥ, [saying], "Worship Allāh," and at once they were two parties conflicting. (27:45)
